name: sso-react-nestjs-demo
description: Educational SSO demo: NestJS IdP + two React SPAs (OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sso/oidc-client && npm run build -w @sso/idp && npm run build -w @sso/app-a && npm run build -w @sso/app-b
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @sso/oidc-client && npm run typecheck -w @sso/idp && npm run typecheck -w @sso/app-a && npm run typecheck -w @sso/app-b
